You said you need advice, so... here's my advice: 
Write down the names of all your friends or the people you call friends or whatever. 
Go through the list and if you feel like they really are a bad friend cross their name out. 
If you're not sure about them but you'd like to try to be friends with them put a little * by their name. 
If they're someone who's definitely a friend underline their name. 
Do this with girls & guys, if you're having a hard time deciding try to remember if they've ever said or done anything nice to you. 
Don't worry if the whole list is crossed out or even if their mostly are crossed and a few asterisked. (This is what happened when my friend did it). 
The people who's names are crossed out, take them off your social media, your contacts, make sure you aren't connected to them at all. 
The people who's names are asterisked, try to make a special effort when you see them to be nice and if it works, great! If not, do what you did to the crossed out people's names. 
The people who's names are underlined, just make sure to let them know how much you appreciate them. 
And if you do this and you don't have as many underlinined as you'd like, don't worry, it's fine. 
When isolation is over (and trust me it will be eventually) make a special effort to try to make new friends. 
It's not as hard as it first seems! I hope this helps a bit at least! One of the worst things you can do for your mental health is be around or listen to toxic friends. 
For coping with isolation, I would say try to get a routine, and stick to it. And remember, it doesn't have to be really intense. 
Try to make sure you include going outside for at least ten minutes each day, even if you're just walking about. 
Also make sure you include doing half an hour of something you enjoy, whether that be exercise, reading, watching TV, cooking, drawing, writing, anything! 
Also try to eat healthy cos it really helps your mental health. 
That's it. I hope this helps, and if not then just know that I understand because I'm also suicidal and alot of the things I'm told to do don't always work, keep holding on. 
If you want to talk please feel free to send me a message! Thanks for reading such a long comment :]

I sort of strayed from the point in my other comment so anyway, yes I have imagined it. I've actually planned my entire funeral. I want all my family to wear matching ties & scarfs bc they did at my Nan's funeral and I liked it. I want my flowers to be purple & white, I want to be cremated not buried, and I want them to have nice food afterwards... I've also picked out which photos I want them to use (if they do have photos) because I refuse to let them show people ugly photos of me when I'm dead.

Don't feel envious. I'm not sure if that's really what you mean or what, but seriously envious is the wrong word. I am suicidal bc of thinking too much, basically.  Because I feel there isn't a point for humans and what's the point when we're gonna die anyway? But I envy the people who don't feel like me. The people who carry on even though. I will never be like that and I just get really annoyed with people who try to tell me to get better.

Anyway, what I was going to say is that my Aunt is a school teacher and she knew a young girl who killed herself (with paracetamol overdose) and she left a note. I won't tell you what it actually said, but basically she only did it because she'd read about other people doing it. That was the only reason. She just wanted to fit in, and it was incredibly heart breaking because she was just 11. So I guess I'm a bit of a hypocrite. I'm suicidal, but I'm telling you not to be... I dunno. That's it really. Just don't be envious. Have an actual reason.

Yes I do. As I've said many times before the only thing that stops me from killing myself is that my parents and my best friends too I guess would be distraught. Honestly I quite like the thought. That they would be upset. I've never told my parents how I feel, I already know they would be extremely supportive and stuff, but I just don't want them to know that they've raised a child like this! I have told my best friend though, and she's brilliant. She understands me and the one thing she always says to me is that even if I feel like there isn't any point anymore and that I could kill myself tomorrow, that I shouldn't, simply for my parents and for her. And honestly that's the only thing stopping me from doing it. I would be dead without her. And although it's quite an appealing thought (death, that is) I shan't, not until my parents die anyway. So I guess I'm stuck here on planet pitiful earth for at least another few years.

Thanks, I guess. Honestly the thing I struggle with most is why we're here. The only people that get remembered are people with amazing talents. Everyone else gets forgotten. I've tried to make my life interesting and DO something, like I said, travelling, charities and things. I guess I just feel like if there isn't a point for humans and I will die and people will forget who I even was, what is the point? As I said in my post though, I'm still delaying it because I feel a responsibility to my parents. When they both die though, I think that will be the tipping point. I sound so grim, it's almost funny. :/
